notes.title: Patch Notes V0.0.4
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hey Couriers![/b][/h2][p]Today, we've added some new features to enhance your gaming experience. 🚚✨[/p][h3]
Change List:[/h3][list][*][p]The motorcycle repair center is now open. The repair area has been moved indoors.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657080/bd8db5a873d3895b44bd7ceaed64ade3411a667b.jpg"][/img]  [/p][/*][*][p]A bug that occurred when motorcycles were recovered using the R key has been fixed. The recovery height has been reduced. Visual and audio elements have been added during recovery.[/p][/*][*][p]Engine start sounds have been added when mounting motorcycles. Each motorcycle has a unique sound design.[/p][/*][*][p]The rate at which motorcycle health and fuel decrease has been increased.[/p][/*][*][p]A bug related to the helmet worn when riding motorcycles has been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]The location synchronization issue of the package launched from the catapult has been fixed.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Ride safe and stay tuned! 🚴‍♂️[/p][p]Crixel Games.[/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes V0.0.3
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hey Couriers![/b][/h2][p]Today, we've added some new features to enhance your gaming experience. 🚚✨[/p][h3]
Change List:[/h3][list][*][p]The order times have been increased from 02:30 to 03:00.[/p][/*][*][p]A new app called "Orders" has been added to your phone. You can now get navigation to delivery addresses more easily.[/p][/*][*][p]The navigation directions on the mini map have been improved. Incorrect markings have been corrected.[/p][/*][*][p]Collision sounds have been added to the motorcycles.[/p][/*][*][p]The waiting time to get on the motorcycle has been reduced.[/p][/*][*][p]A helpful tip now appears at 22:00 to remind you that you can end your day.[/p][/*][*][p]Some helper key tips have been repositioned and improved.[/p][/*][*][p]A new red button has been added to turn off the phone.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now exit computers and other interface screens using the ESC key.[/p][/*][*][p]The end-of-day summary screen has been improved with a better user interface.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Ride safe and stay tuned! 🚴‍♂️[/p][p]Crixel Games.[/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes V0.0.2
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hey Couriers![/b][/h2][p]Today, we've added some new features to enhance your gaming experience. 🚚✨[/p][h3]
Change List:[/h3][list][*][p]Catapult tasks now give 5 times more tips.[/p][/*][*][p]A new stage has been added at the end of the game's tutorial section, where you can purchase the 'Bobber' motorcycle.[/p][/*][*][p]The TPS camera's rotation control in motorcycles has been improved.[/p][/*][*][p]The visibility of spikes on some roads has been increased for easier spotting from a distance.[/p][/*][*][p]A button has been added to the main menu to show the updates added to the game (Patch Notes).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Ride safe and stay tuned! 🚴‍♂️[/p][p]Crixel Games.[/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes V0.0.1
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hey Couriers![/b][/h2][p]We’ve just rolled out a new update that squashes some annoying bugs and introduces a brand-new feature to improve your delivery experience. 🚚✨[/p][h3]
Change List:[/h3][list][*][p]Motorcycle damage has been significantly reduced.[/p][/*][*][p]The number of spikes on certain roads that caused tire punctures has been decreased.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Restore Function[/b] – If your bike gets stuck, press [b]R[/b] to restore it! You can also check out all controls from the panel on the right side of the screen while riding.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players could fly out of the map through certain gaps.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug related to the functionality of the [b]V-Sync[/b] option in the graphics settings.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Ride safe and stay tuned! 🚴‍♂️[/p][p]Crixel Games.[/p]
